method.memory: MiB; sampled process-tree PSS includes Node driver and native sidecars; RSS also retained
method.cpu: Sum of maximum sampled CPU ticks per PID/start-time identity; approximate, may miss the final sample before exit
method.latency: Same read + shell exec turn, synthetic inference, six turns per guest; cold means fresh process/storage with warm host file cache
method.scope: Small local experiment, not production capacity or cloud billing
